description: Personal credit institution income-statement skeleton adapted from the bank profile and supplied OneMain reference presentation. All 85 user-supplied unique concepts are retained once. Issuer presentation, measurements and overlapping scopes require review; hierarchy prescribes no arithmetic.
classification_notes: The supplied concept list defines industry coverage; no frequency threshold or completeness for any single issuer has been independently established.
The reference guides presentation only; its labels, negative expense display and analytical results do not establish XBRL equivalence, source-fact signs or issuer-reported calculations.
No unsupported EBIT, EBITDA, unusual-item total, commission total or separate depreciation subtotal is invented.
Revenue net of interest expense, net interest income, gross revenue and noninterest income are distinct scopes. Do not mix gross and net presentation or deduct interest expense twice.
Insurance services revenue may include net earned premiums; general expense totals, G&A and functional expense disclosures can overlap.
Every concept has its own node. Totals and components are retained without automatic addition; missing facts are not zeros.
Review status indicates a specific unresolved scope or presentation issue. Proposed mappings still require issuer-specific dimensions, attribution, units and source-fact checks.

metadata_contract.period_type: Taxonomy periodType verified for every supplied concept.
metadata_contract.unit_type: Taxonomy monetary, shares or per-share type; no conversion is implied.
metadata_contract.contra: False for these income statement concepts; expense and gain/loss signs depend on source facts and presentation.

taxonomy_reference.note: Metadata and definitions checked against local official 2026 schema and documentation copies. Historical filings retain their own taxonomy and units.

sources.description: 85 user-supplied unique us-gaap concepts for SIC 6141.

nodes.label: Revenue and Interest Presentation
nodes.classification_note: Gross revenue, net-of-interest revenue, net interest income and noninterest income are alternative or overlapping presentation levels. The reference presentation ordering does not establish an additive reconciliation.

children.label: Reported Revenue Alternatives
children.classification_note: Total revenue, customer-contract revenue and revenue net of interest expense differ in scope. A net-of-interest amount must not have interest expense deducted again.

children.label: Reported Revenue
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

concepts.name: us-gaap:Revenues
concepts.review_reason: Generic revenue requires issuer-specific gross-versus-net review, especially whether lending interest and insurance revenue are included and whether interest expense is already deducted.

children.label: Customer-Contract Revenue, Excluding Assessed Tax
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax
concepts.review_reason: Revenue under customer-contract guidance can exclude lending interest and insurance contracts; it cannot stand for total consumer-finance revenue without a scope reconciliation.

children.label: Revenue, Net of Interest Expense
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense
concepts.review_reason: This revenue measure already deducts interest expense when interest is recognized within revenue; avoid subtracting that same expense again in a gross-revenue presentation.

children.label: Operating Interest and Dividend Income
children.classification_note: Interest-only and interest-plus-dividend totals have different scopes. Loan, portfolio, consumer and securities amounts can be included in either aggregate and may overlap one another.

children.label: Operating Interest and Dividend Income
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

children.label: Operating Interest Income
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

children.label: Interest and Fees on Loans and Leases
children.classification_note: Consumer loans are a product subset; held-in-portfolio is a holding classification. Both may intersect the all-loan-and-lease measure and must not be added as mutually exclusive components.

children.label: Loan and Lease Interest and Fees
Portfolio Loan and Lease Interest and Fees
Operating Securities Interest Income
children.classification_note: AFS debt interest is a portfolio-specific operating income measure; it can already be included in operating interest totals.

children.label: Operating Interest on AFS Debt Securities
Other Interest and Dividend Income
children.classification_note: Residual interest and dividends may already be included in broader operating interest-and-dividend totals; issuer residual scope must be reconciled.

children.label: Interest Expense
children.classification_note: InterestExpense and InterestExpenseOperating are alternative aggregate scopes. Debt, borrowing, maturity and deposit details may be included in those totals; do not add totals to their breakdowns.

children.label: Interest Expense
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

children.label: Operating Interest Expense
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

children.label: Borrowing and Debt Interest Expense
children.classification_note: Borrowing and debt totals can overlap. Long-term debt and short-term borrowing interest use maturity scopes and are not automatically additional to debt or borrowing totals.

children.label: Deposit Interest Expense
children.classification_note: Deposit interest is retained for industry issuers with deposit-taking operations; it is distinct from interest earned on deposits placed with other banks.

children.label: Other Interest Expense
children.classification_note: Other interest expense is an issuer-defined residual and may already be included in reported total interest expense.

children.label: Reported Net Interest Measures
children.classification_note: Net interest income and combined operating/nonoperating net interest have different activity scopes. Both overlap gross interest income and expense; neither is additional revenue.

children.label: Net Interest Income (Expense)
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

children.label: Operating and Nonoperating Net Interest
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestRevenueExpenseNet
concepts.review_reason: This concept combines operating and nonoperating interest income and expense; reconcile its activity scope before substituting it for operating net interest income.

children.label: Noninterest Income
children.classification_note: The noninterest-income total can include servicing, insurance, lease and residual income. Categories preserve reported scope and do not prescribe addition to that total.

children.label: Noninterest Income
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

children.label: Financial Asset Servicing Fees
children.classification_note: Contractual servicing, late and ancillary fees relate to servicing financial assets; they do not represent all origination fees or all commissions.

children.label: Contractual Servicing, Late and Ancillary Fees
Insurance Revenue
children.classification_note: Insurance services revenue can include net earned premiums and insurance fees or commissions. Net premiums are a potentially included component, not additional revenue.

children.label: Insurance Services Revenue
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

children.label: Operating Lease Income
children.classification_note: Operating lease income is a lessor revenue stream and is distinct from lessee lease expense and interest income.

children.label: Other Noninterest Income
children.classification_note: Other noninterest income and other operating noninterest income can be alternative residual scopes; reconcile their contents instead of summing them.

nodes.label: Credit Loss Provisions
nodes.classification_note: Loan-only, loan/lease/other and financing-receivable credit-loss measures differ in coverage. Accounts-receivable provisions are a separate exposure scope. Broad and narrow provisions may overlap; reversals retain the reported sign.

children.label: Loan, Lease and Other Loss Provision
Financing Receivable Credit Loss Expense (Reversal), Excluding Interest

nodes.label: Net Interest Income After Provision
nodes.classification_note: The supplied after-provision concept covers net interest income after loan-loss provision, excluding noninterest income; it is not total net revenue after all provisions.

children.label: Net Interest Income After Loan Loss Provision
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

nodes.label: Expenses and Cost Presentation
nodes.classification_note: Expense aggregates and functional categories can overlap. Interest and provisions may already be included in some aggregates; contra=false is not a sign multiplier or an instruction to deduct every node.

children.label: Reported Expense Alternatives
children.classification_note: Noninterest expense, operating expenses and costs-and-expenses are alternative scopes. None is an additional component of another aggregate.

children.label: Noninterest Expense
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

children.label: Operating Expenses
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingExpenses
concepts.review_reason: Operating expense coverage varies by issuer and may include credit provisions or operating interest; reconcile it to noninterest expense before selecting an expense aggregate.

children.label: Costs and Expenses
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CostsAndExpenses
concepts.review_reason: This aggregate covers cost of sales and operating expenses; inspect whether reported interest, provisions or insurance costs are included before combining it with other expense totals.

children.label: Cost of Goods and Services
children.classification_note: The taxonomy cost-of-goods-and-services concept excludes financial-services costs. The reference presentation labels do not establish equivalence with lender operating costs; production depreciation is a potentially included component.

children.label: Cost of Goods and Services Sold
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold
concepts.review_reason: The taxonomy definition excludes costs of financial services and other revenue-generating activities; confirm the reporting activity before mapping this amount to a consumer lender operating-cost line.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSoldDepreciationAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: This depreciation and amortization relates directly to production or service delivery and may be included in cost of goods and services; keep it distinct from nonproduction depreciation and avoid deducting it twice.

children.label: General and Administrative Expenses
children.classification_note: Other G&A is a possible component of total G&A. Labor, technology, marketing and other functional disclosures can also be included in broader G&A amounts.

children.label: General and Administrative Expense
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

children.label: Labor and Related Expense
children.classification_note: Labor and related expense may already be included in G&A or other operating cost aggregates; it does not establish a separate additional cost.

children.label: Occupancy and Equipment Expense
children.classification_note: Occupancy and equipment costs may include related depreciation or lease costs; reconcile included costs before combining these lines with separate amortization amounts.

children.label: Nonproduction Depreciation and Amortization
children.classification_note: DepreciationAndAmortization is a nonproduction scope under the taxonomy definition. Intangible amortization can be included in that amount; neither is automatically additional to functional expenses.

children.label: Technology and Data Processing
children.classification_note: Information technology and processing expense may be included in G&A or other noninterest expense aggregates.

children.label: Professional and Contract Services
children.classification_note: Contract and professional service costs may be included in G&A or other reported expense categories; no separate legal or consulting subtotal is invented.

children.label: Selling, Marketing and Advertising
children.classification_note: Selling and marketing can include marketing and advertising; marketing-and-advertising can include each narrower measure. These scopes are alternatives, not four additive cost buckets.

children.label: Insurance Benefits and Deposit Insurance
children.classification_note: Policyholder benefits and claims, net of assumed or ceded effects, differ from FDIC deposit-insurance premiums. Each may already be included in total expenses.

children.label: Other Noninterest Expense
children.classification_note: This residual expense can include narrower functional expenses shown elsewhere; confirm issuer composition before combining it with those amounts.

nodes.label: Reported Gross Profit and Operating Income
nodes.classification_note: Gross profit and operating income are different presentation levels. No EBIT, EBITDA or reference presentation subtotal is derived from these concepts.

children.label: Gross Profit
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GrossProfit
concepts.review_reason: Gross profit deducts costs directly attributable to revenue generation; confirm which lender or insurance costs are included before comparing it with operating income.

children.label: Operating Income (Loss)
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss
concepts.review_reason: Reported operating income may classify financing interest and provisions differently from the reference presentation; verify its expense coverage before constructing a pretax-income reconciliation.

nodes.label: Other Income, Expense and Transaction Results
nodes.classification_note: Only explicitly nonoperating concepts establish nonoperating scope. Other results may already be included in revenue or operating expense; separate grouping does not imply nonrecurrence or an extra pretax adjustment.

children.label: Nonoperating Investment and Interest Results
children.classification_note: Nonoperating investment income can include interest. Interest-only, net-interest and broader investment income overlap; do not add them without an issuer reconciliation.

children.label: Equity-Method Investment Results
children.classification_note: Equity-method earnings and realized disposal gains are different result types; disposal presentation may be included in other reported gain/loss amounts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentRealizedGainLossOnDisposal
concepts.review_reason: A realized disposal result differs from the periodic share of equity-method earnings; verify whether it is already included in investment or other income before presenting it separately.

children.label: Loan and Note Sale Results
children.classification_note: Note receivable sales may be included in net loan-sale results; these are overlapping instrument scopes rather than additive gains.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfLoansNet
concepts.review_reason: Net loan-sale results may cover several loan classes and include note-sale results; confirm portfolio scope and whether other operating income already includes this amount.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfNotesReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Note-sale results can be a subset of broader loan-sale gains or losses; verify the notes and reporting scope before presenting both amounts.

children.label: Mortgage-Backed Securities Sale Results
children.classification_note: MBS sale results relate to securitized debt securities and are distinct from sales of whole mortgage loans. They can be included in broader investment income.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfMortgageBackedSecuritiesMBS
concepts.review_reason: This concept measures net sales results on mortgage-backed debt securities rather than whole loans; check its inclusion in investment or noninterest income before adding a separate line.

children.label: Debt Repurchase Results
children.classification_note: Repurchase gains or losses concern the issuer liability, not investment sales or interest expense. Separate grouping does not establish unusual or nonrecurring treatment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnRepurchaseOfDebtInstrument
concepts.review_reason: This result compares debt repurchase price with the issuer debt carrying amount; establish whether the filing includes it in other expense or presents it separately before a pretax reconciliation.

children.label: Foreign Currency Transaction Results
children.classification_note: Transaction gains and losses differ from translation adjustments in OCI. The operating or nonoperating location requires issuer presentation context.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossBeforeTax
concepts.review_reason: The pretax result includes realized and unrealized transaction effects; verify income-statement location and avoid substituting foreign-currency translation OCI.

children.label: Other Income and Expense
children.classification_note: Generic other income and expense have unspecified activity scope; explicitly nonoperating residuals may overlap these broader captions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherIncome
concepts.review_reason: Other income has no guaranteed operating or nonoperating scope; inspect its contents and overlap with residual noninterest income before selecting a presentation line.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherExpenses
concepts.review_reason: Other expense can include costs already present in operating or transaction expense groups; issuer classification is needed before treating it as a separate nonoperating deduction.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingIncomeExpense
concepts.review_reason: This explicit nonoperating residual can include transaction results shown elsewhere in this skeleton; reconcile its composition rather than adding all candidate adjustments.

nodes.label: Tax, Earnings and Attribution
nodes.classification_note: Pretax, continuing, discontinued, reporting-entity and common-shareholder earnings represent successive or alternative scopes. Do not add them or subtract attribution adjustments twice.

children.label: Pretax Income
children.classification_note: Use the reported historical concept and verify its noncontrolling-interest and continuing-operations scope rather than deriving it from overlapping presentation groups.

children.label: Continuing Operations Pretax Income
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

children.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
children.classification_note: Reported income tax expense is distinct from policyholder or other operating taxes; sign and any benefit require source-fact context.

children.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

children.label: Continuing Operations Income
children.classification_note: Continuing-operations income excludes discontinued operations; reconcile noncontrolling-interest treatment against issuer presentation.

children.label: Continuing Operations Income (Loss)
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

children.label: Discontinued Operations
children.classification_note: The supplied discontinued result is net of tax and attributable to the reporting entity; it is not a pretax operating adjustment.

children.label: Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Reporting Entity
Net Income and Attribution
children.classification_note: NetIncomeLoss is the reporting-entity earnings measure; noncontrolling-interest income is a separate attribution amount, not an automatic second deduction from it.

children.label: Net Income (Loss)
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

children.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interests
Common Shareholder Income and Preferred Dividends
children.classification_note: The basic common-shareholder earnings numerator may already reflect preferred dividend adjustments; do not deduct those adjustments a second time.

children.label: Net Income Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
children.classification_note: Reported aggregate or subtotal; neither this node kind nor sibling placement prescribes arithmetic.

nodes.label: Earnings per Share
nodes.classification_note: Basic and diluted EPS are alternative denominators. Total, continuing and discontinued EPS use different earnings scopes; do not sum total EPS with its components.

children.label: Total EPS
children.classification_note: Basic EPS and diluted EPS are distinct per-share measures; neither is a monetary income total.

children.label: Continuing Operations EPS
children.classification_note: Continuing-operations EPS excludes discontinued results; verify numerator attribution and share-class consistency before any component reconciliation.

children.label: Discontinued Operations EPS
children.classification_note: These EPS concepts cover after-tax day-to-day discontinued-operation results and do not automatically cover every disposal gain or loss included in discontinued income.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationIncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationNetOfTaxPerBasicShare
concepts.review_reason: This basic per-share concept covers after-tax day-to-day discontinued business activities; verify whether disposal results are reported separately before using it as all discontinued-operations EPS.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationIncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationNetOfTaxPerDilutedShare
concepts.review_reason: This diluted per-share concept covers after-tax day-to-day discontinued activities; reconcile disposal results and the diluted denominator before comparing it with total discontinued earnings.

nodes.label: Weighted-Average Shares
nodes.classification_note: Basic and diluted weighted-average shares are period denominators, not balance-sheet instant share counts and not additive amounts.

nodes.label: Supplementary Earnings Disclosures
nodes.classification_note: Derivative results require instrument, hedge and presentation context and are not automatically additional operating revenue.

children.label: Derivative Gains and Losses
children.classification_note: Pretax derivative results may already be included in interest, revenue or other earnings lines. Hedge designation and income-versus-OCI treatment require filing context.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsNetPretax
concepts.review_reason: Net pretax derivative results can cover different hedge relationships and reporting locations; reconcile income-versus-OCI recognition and inclusion in interest or other income before selecting a primary line.
